facts.text: Suites are named to honour Cambodia's history or four former residents: Charlie Chaplin, Jacqueline Kennedy, Charles de Gaulle and Somerset Maugham.

facts.text: Rooms have high ceilings, wooden floors and marble bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Today, the traditional high ceilings, wooden floors and marble bathrooms are complemented by all the hallmarks of contemporary luxury

facts.text: State Rooms have air-conditioning, overhead fans and windows that open for fresh air.

facts.text: The Elephant Bar offers over 200 different types of gin, including its own locally crafted Elephant Bar Gin.
facts.excerpt: The Elephant Bar at Raffles Hotel Le Royal offers over 200 different types of gin, including the legendary Sipsmith Raffles 1915 as well as our own locally crafted Elephant Bar Gin.

facts.text: The Elephant Bar Gin Experience includes two hours of unlimited gin cocktails and a gin tasting.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy two hours of unlimited gin cocktails and a gin tasting as part of this stupendous gin experience.

facts.text: The Elephant Bar has a daily happy hour with 40% off selected drinks between 6pm and 8pm.
facts.excerpt: Every day, the city’s favourite watering hole offers 40% off selected drinks between 6.00pm and 8.00pm.

facts.text: Raffles Spa offers traditional Khmer and modern treatments.
facts.excerpt: Every element is carefully considered, offering traditional Khmer and modern treatments.

facts.text: The spa has male and female wet areas with saunas, steam rooms and Jacuzzi, plus an outdoor lap pool and fitness centre.
facts.excerpt: Our beautiful, relaxing space features male and female wet areas with saunas, steam rooms and Jacuzzi as well as five comfortably appointed treatment rooms, outdoor lap pool and fitness centre.

facts.text: The signature Khmer massage, known as chad ta shai, is a vigorous, firm pressure point massage.

facts.text: Afternoon Tea is served at the hotel.
